intro: I'm a software engineer pursuing Computer Science at the University of Embu. I build responsive, user-friendly web experiences and enjoy exploring how thoughtful code and design can solve everyday problems.
aboutHeading: Building useful digital experiences, one project at a time.
aboutParagraphs: I'm a software engineer pursuing a BSc in Computer Science at the University of Embu (2024–2028). I'm deepening my foundation in programming, computational thinking, and problem-solving while turning ideas into useful digital experiences.
My current focus is frontend development: using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to create responsive, accessible interfaces. I'm keen to keep learning and apply my skills through hands-on projects.
Coding and athletics are two of my favorite interests. Athletics helps me practice discipline, consistency, and focus, while coding lets me explore ideas and build useful things.
